product_metadata.title: BESTCHIC Electric Heated Blanket Queen Size 84" x 90", Fast Heating Blanket 100% Polyester Soft Flannel, 4 Heating Levels 10 Hours Auto-Off, ETL Certified Dual Controllers, Machine Washable (Grey)
features: Soft & Warm: BESTCHIC heated blanket queen is made of double-layer flannel that gently wraps you in warmth, coziness and comfort, add a layer of comforter on top to retain the heat around your body in very cold weather.
Certifications: ETL certified and built-in overheat protection system to avoid overheating and make our heating blanket queen size safer to use.
4 Heating Levels &10H Automatic Shutdown: This queen heated blanket features a 10-hour auto shut-off timer and a 4 setting temperature control to ensure your safety.
Machine Washable: BESTCHIC heating blanket throw can be washed, which is easy care. Carefully read the instructions and be sure to disconnect the power cord before you wash it.

5 Year Limited Warranty: Manufacturer's 5-year limited warranty included, 30 day return or exchange, You'll receive an electric throw, a controller and a user manual. Please follow the instructions carefully before using. If you encounter any problems, please feel free to contact us and we'll provide you with a satisfactory solution within 24 hours.
